title: Forensic facial reconstruction rules (skull to face)

queue.claim: In blind tests of computer-modelled Manchester-method reconstructions against CT of living subjects (Wilkinson et al. 2006; Lee et al. 2012; Short et al. 2014), about 50–70 % of the surface fell within ±2–2.5 mm. Automated CT-template methods report about 2–4 mm mean error.
queue.query: blind accuracy assessment computer-modeled forensic facial reconstruction CT live subjects percentage surface within 2 mm Wilkinson

queue.claim: The OrtogOnBlender add-on and Cícero Moraes's Blender method of deforming a donor CT head exist as an open-source forensic approximation toolchain (status, licence and Blender compatibility in 2026 unverified).
queue.query: OrtogOnBlender add-on license Blender version Cicero Moraes forensic facial approximation
